semiconductor_relevance: High — CG Semi is focused on semiconductor assembly, testing, and packaging, playing a crucial role in India's semiconductor manufacturing landscape.
summary: CG Semi Private Limited specializes in Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Testing (OSAT) services, providing comprehensive testing and packaging solutions for semiconductor products. As part of the Murugappa Group, the company is investing significantly in expanding its production capabilities to support India's self-reliance in semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.India: CG Semi is strategically positioned in India, with planned investments exceeding USD 1 billion to enhance local semiconductor manufacturing capabilities.
